parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description:
Returns a list of all Direct Cost Items for a Project.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[origin_id]
parameters.description: Origin ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Origin ID.

parameters.name: filters[invoice_number]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) with the specified Invoice Number.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[payment_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) with a payment date within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[received_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) with a received date within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the Direct Cost Item. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete this item.

amount.description: Grand total of the Direct Cost Item, as a decimal string. For backwards compatibility this mirrors grand_total.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null for active items.

description.description: Free-text description of the Direct Cost Item.

direct_cost_type.description: Category of the Direct Cost Item.

direct_cost_date.description: Date the direct cost was incurred, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

grand_total.description: Sum of all line item amounts on the Direct Cost Item, as a decimal string.

grand_total_with_tax.description: Sum of all line item amounts on the Direct Cost Item plus tax, as a decimal string.

invoice_number.description: Vendor invoice number. Present only for invoice-type items; must be unique per vendor within the tool.

origin_data.description: Opaque third-party payload stored with the item for external-system integrations. Not interpreted by Procore.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this item in the originating external system; used to correlate synced records.

payment_date.description: Date the direct cost was paid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

received_date.description: Date the direct cost was received, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: Review/approval state of the Direct Cost Item.

terms.description: Agreed payment terms for the invoice (for example, Net 30).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

vendor.description: Display name of the vendor billed on the Direct Cost Item.

vendor_id.description: Identifier of the vendor billed on the Direct Cost Item. Required for invoice-type items.

vendor_name.description: Display name of the vendor billed on the Direct Cost Item.

base_currency_iso_code.description: Base Currency ISO Code configured from project level; It'll be populated only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity

currency_exchange_rate.description: Exchange Rate from currency_iso_code to base_currency_iso_code; It'll be populated only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled

tax_breakdown.description: Header-level tax rollup. Always included on the response as an object, including when Direct Cost taxes are disabled. tax_details is an empty array when no stored tax details are returned. Presence of this key does not mean taxes are enabled.

subtotal.description: Sum of line-item amounts before tax

tax_total.description: Total tax across all line items

grand_total.description: subtotal plus tax_total. Equals the top-level grand_total_with_tax.

tax_details.description: One entry per component tax code rate that produced tax on this Direct Cost. Group entries by selected_tax_code_id and selected_tax_code_rate_key.

tax_code_rate_id.description: Rate version of tax_code_id that produced this amount

amount.description: Tax amount for this component rate, summed across line items

taxable_amount.description: Taxable basis this component rate was applied against

selected_tax_code_id.description: Tax code selected on the line item

selected_tax_code_rate_key.description: Opaque identifier of the selected tax code's rate version. Entries with the same selected_tax_code_id and key belong to the same rate. Compare it for equality only; do not parse it.

employee.description: Employee (project contact) associated with the Direct Cost Item.

id.description: Contact ID of the employee (references the project Contact record, not LoginInformation).

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/direct_costs?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Borigin_id%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Binvoice_number%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bpayment_date%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Breceived_date%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"attachments\":[\"string\"],\"direct_cost\":{\"description\":\"Invoice for April\",\"direct_cost_date\":\"2016-12-14\",\"employee_id\":43223,\"invoice_number\":\"Invoice # abc123\",\"origin_data\":\"OD-2398273424\",\"origin_id\":\"px-1990\",\"payment_date\":\"2017-01-10\",\"received_date\":\"2017-01-08\",\"status\":\"approved\",\"terms\":\"Net 50\",\"vendor_id\":23423,\"direct_cost_type\":\"invoice\",\"currency_configuration\":{\"currency_iso_code\":\"USD\",\"currency_exchange_rate\":0.65},\"line_items\":[{\"manual_amount\":1000,\"wbs_code_id\":1989,\"description\":\"100' of Copper Piping\",\"direct_cost_id\":81753,\"origin_data\":\"OD-2398273424\",\"origin_id\":\"px-1990\",\"quantity\":82.0201,\"ref\":\"PQRS5678\",\"tax_code_id\":1,\"unit_cost\":12.03,\"uom\":\"cubic feet\",\"funding_rule_id\":12345}]}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/direct_costs", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

payload = "{\"attachments\":[\"string\"],\"direct_cost\":{\"description\":\"Home Depot Purchase\",\"employee_id\":14522,\"direct_cost_date\":\"2016-12-14\",\"origin_data\":\"OD-2398273424\",\"origin_id\":\"px-1990\",\"payment_date\":\"2017-01-05\",\"received_date\":\"2017-01-10\",\"status\":\"approved\",\"terms\":\"Net 30\",\"vendor_id\":43122,\"currency_configuration\":{\"currency_iso_code\":\"USD\",\"currency_exchange_rate\":0.65},\"line_items\":[{\"id\":1234,\"manual_amount\":1000,\"wbs_code_id\":1989,\"description\":\"100' of Copper Piping\",\"direct_cost_id\":81753,\"origin_data\":\"OD-2398273424\",\"origin_id\":\"px-1990\",\"quantity\":82.0201,\"ref\":\"PQRS5678\",\"tax_code_id\":1,\"unit_cost\":12.03,\"uom\":\"cubic feet\",\"funding_rule_id\":12345}]}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/direct_costs/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

x-changelog.description: Using manual_amount will set the amount of the line item to this value regardless of the unit_cost and quantity. extended_type was not being used.

x-changelog.summary: Added deleted_at parameter to the response
x-changelog.description: This parameter was listed in the response, but was not actually being returned with the API response

x-changelog.summary: Added currency_configuration to the output.
x-changelog.description: Creation of new response field currency_configuration, that will hold currency information for the invoice

x-changelog.summary: Add origin_id and origin_data to the request body for the Direct Cost update endpoint
x-changelog.description: origin_id and origin_data are now accepted in the request body for Direct Costs as well as Line Items

x-changelog.summary: Add base_currency_iso_code and currency_exchange_rate to the response for the Direct Cost update endpoint
x-changelog.description: base_currency_iso_code and currency_exchange_rate are now displayed in the response body for Direct Costs update

x-changelog.summary: Direct Cost APIs no longer support concurrent update requests for the same Direct Cost
x-changelog.description: PATCH and DELETE APIs can return a 409 Conflict response if a concurrent update request for the same Direct Cost is detected. To avoid this wait for the first request to complete before sending another request for the same Direct Cost.

x-changelog.summary: Made currency configuration fields nullable and changed format in Direct Cost Update v1.1 response
x-changelog.description: Made base_currency_iso_code, currency_exchange_rate, and currency_iso_code nullable in currency_configuration response. Changed currency_exchange_rate format from float to string.

x-changelog.summary: Added funding_rule_id field to nested line items
x-changelog.description: Nested line items now include a funding_rule_id field with the ID of the funding rule associated with the line item, or null when unassociated.

x-changelog.summary: Accepts optional funding_rule_id on nested line items
x-changelog.description: Nested line items accept an optional funding_rule_id parameter associating the line item with a project-level funding rule. Pass null to disassociate.

delete.description: Delete a specific Direct Cost Item and its Line Items. This action does not support concurrent requests. If there is an attempt to delete a Direct Cost that is being updated or deleted by another request, a 409 Conflict error will be returned.

id.description: ID of the deleted Direct Cost Item.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("DELETE", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/direct_costs/%7Bid%7D", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
